authenticity.basis: Formal OP1 C02 replay observed 343 Linear4bit calls per model forward; the frozen census projects 7,444,815 NF4 calls, of which 7,441,042 (99.9493204332%) are M=1 decode calls across all 11 requests.

bottleneck.basis: Frozen selection probe measured the full 343-weight streaming sequence for eager and fullgraph compile against a same-day Triton triad ceiling.

capability.basis: All 343 exact C02 modules share the predeclared row-major nested-NF4 invariants (block 64, second-level block 256, uint8 packed/code indices, BF16 activation/output). Triton 3.7.1 on sm_89 can express nibble decode, nested scale lookup, and fused reduction without materializing BF16 weights.

deliverability.basis: A torch.library op can consume the existing packed tensors without changing parameters/state_dict; Linear4bit can dispatch only for M=1 BF16 no-grad nested NF4 and fall back unchanged for prefill or any invariant miss.

backlog.evidence: 343 calls/forward; 99.9493204332% of projected NF4 invocations are decode; all 14 decode rows measured in the frozen selection probe.
